data.rationale: The proposal follows the same flight, hotel, tour and note steps in the right order with matching parameters, but it opens the top hotel instead of the first one rated 8 or higher, folds activity and destination into one tour_query (so the note's text differs), and leaves out the Google consent step and the "do not click Select, Reserve or Book" guardrails.
